text:
Maria S: escalating — Copperline Financial POC is at risk. They want dedicated capacity + CISO sign-off this week. pricing ask is a 30% committed-discount vs our standard Dedicated Tiers.
Sam J: thanks for flagging. what's blocking the CISO sign-off exactly?
Maria S: Copperline's security team says our egress policy and KMS integration details are missing from the questionnaire. also they want a performance SLA for 99th perc latency on 2k token inference.
Ada L: I reviewed their security questionnaire. Open items: KMS key lifecycle, HSM compatibility, VPC peering diagram, egress IP ranges, SOC2 evidence (we have cert but they asked for latest audit period).
Kevin R: on SLA: Dedicated can hit 99p latency for their baseline load if we size the pool and reserve burst capacity. We need a signed reserved capacity contract.
Priya S: Copperline is pushing to start POC next week — timeline: week 1 ingest -> week 2 integration -> week 3 scale test. Legal wants DPA + subprocessor list before any real data.
Maria S: they're also asking about data residency in us-east only. Can we commit to region pinning for a Dedicated deploy?
Ada L: yes, Dedicated supports region pinning. I'll add config snippet they can use.
Ada L: ```
# sample deploy config for region pinning
deployment: dedicated
region: us-east-1
reserved_capacity: 4xA10G
autoscale: disabled
```
Sam J: pricing: they offered a budget target that's ~30% below our published committed tier. Ask from account: if we do 12-month commit, can we move to 20%?
Jonah (CPO): we can consider 20% on a 12mo committed Dedicated contract if legal/ops risks are low and revenue > $X. Need approval from finance on ARR numbers.
Maria S: action list so far: 1) Ada — provide KMS/HSM integration doc + egress IPs (ETA T+8h) 2) Kevin — confirm 99p latency SLO math and required pool size (ETA T+12h) 3) LegalBot/Legal — DPA + subprocessor review (ETA 48h) 4) Sam/Priya — negotiate pricing and term with Copperline (ETA EOD)
LegalBot: DPA draft uploaded: /internal/legal/dpas/Copperline_DPA_v1.pdf. Need pointer to their legal rep to fast-track redlines.
Priya S: Copperline legal contact is "marta.reyes@copperline.com" — I can loop them in after we confirm the KMS answers.
Kevin R: numbers: to meet 99p for 2k tokens under their expected concurrency (avg 35 qps peak), we recommend 6xA10G reserved with burst pool. That aligns with our Dedicated SKU but will push monthly commit to mid-tier.
Maria S: are there any compliance gaps that would block an enterprise deal (PCI/PII)?
Ada L: no PCI-specific infra gaps in Dedicated, but they asked for encryption at rest with customer-managed keys — we support that with KMS + bring-your-own-key. I'll attach the step-by-step with screenshots.
Sam J: I'll propose 12mo commit @ 20% discount + one-month POC credit to sweeten it. If Legal pushes hard on DPA redlines, offer a 30-day data retention SLA.
Jonah (CPO): approve the commercial approach conditionally. Sales: get finance to run contribution margin with the discount. Ops/Eng: prioritize the KMS answers and a short security call with their CISO.
Maria S: scheduling: I'm booking a 30-min technical huddle with Copperline CISO + our Eng/Sec for tomorrow 10:00am PT. Ada/Kevin can you join?
Ada L: yes.
Kevin R: yes.
Priya S: I'll prep a one-pager for the customer with timeline and next steps.
Sam J: tagging @Jonah — if finance says no on the 20% discount, what's the fallback?
Jonah (CPO): fallback is standard committed tier + 2-week POC with engineering support. We can escalate to exec sponsor match if they push further.
Maria S: thanks everyone. I'll update Copperline and paste meeting invite here. :thumbsup:
Maria S: meeting invite posted: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/xyz
Maria S: follow-ups: Ada/Kevin — drop docs into this thread once uploaded. Sam/Priya — confirm pricing stance after finance call.
Ada L: uploaded KMS integration doc and egress IP list to internal drive: /internal/eng/security/copperline_kms_egress.pdf
Kevin R: uploaded latency SLO calc and recommended pool sizing: /internal/eng/runtime/copperline_latency_plan.pdf
LegalBot: noted — DPA under review, legal assigned: Priya (Legal Ops). ETA 36h.
Sam J: finance sign-off pending. will update before EOD.
Maria S: last check at 18:00 PT today — I'll open a new thread if anything escalates to execs.
